quarterly_data.quarter: Skyworks Solutions press release: Skyworks Completes Combination with Qorvo (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Skyworks completed its combination with Qorvo; the company continues to operate as Skyworks under the SWKS ticker. Per the release, the combined company brings together complementary RF, analog and power technologies with approximately 8,000 engineers and more than 12,000 issued and pending patents. Beyond Mobile, the company says the combination more than doubles Skyworks' addressable market and establishes a platform spanning physical AI and connected edge, defense and aerospace, data center and networking, and automotive, and broadens the technology portfolio into RF GaN, low-voltage power and wired broadband; it also cites strengthened domestic manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 8,000 engineers; more than 12,000 issued and pending patents

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyworks Solutions press release: Skyworks Completes Combination with Qorvo (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company view (combination release): in Mobile the combination broadens Skyworks' RF front-end portfolio, positioning it to benefit from rising RF complexity; as 5G-Advanced evolves and the industry moves toward 6G, smartphones are expected to support more frequency bands, new spectrum and AI-driven features, increasing demand for highly integrated RF solutions. CEO Phil Brace: together the companies are well positioned to deliver more integrated, system-level solutions.

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyworks Solutions press release: Skyworks Completes Combination with Qorvo (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Skyworks will provide financial guidance on its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings call on Nov. 3; the company expects the transaction to be immediately accretive to non-GAAP EPS.
